description: This file provides a security logging utility for the CHRIS backend API, including functions for logging authentication failures, rate limit violations, suspicious activities, and successful authentications with structured JSON events.

methods.name: log_auth_failure( reason: str, client_ip: str, endpoint: str, user_id: Optional[str] = None, additional_info: Optional[Dict[str, Any]] = None )
methods.description: Logs an authentication failure event with details such as reason, client IP, endpoint, user ID, and additional info.

methods.name: log_rate_limit_exceeded( client_ip: str, endpoint: str, request_count: int, window_seconds: int )
methods.description: Logs a rate limit violation event including client IP, endpoint, request count, and the rate limit window.

methods.name: log_suspicious_activity( activity_type: str, client_ip: str, details: Dict[str, Any] )
methods.description: Logs suspicious activity events with type, client IP, and detailed contextual information.

methods.name: log_auth_success( user_id: str, client_ip: str, endpoint: str )
methods.description: Logs a successful authentication event with user ID, client IP, and endpoint information.
